luckycapture.previewOnlyNotice: This mode is camera preview only. Choose Automatic or repeated exposures to record.
luckycapture.invalidCameraSettings: Enter a valid camera value within the displayed range.
luckycapture.invalidRoi: Enter whole-pixel coordinates and a region inside the sensor (at least 2 x 2 pixels).
luckycapture.helpexposure: Exposure per frame. 0.2 ms = 0.0002 s; 1 ms = 0.001 s. 20 ms is the default, not a fixed minimum. Use shorter exposures for bright solar or lunar targets within the camera limits.
luckycapture.helpgain: Amplifies the camera signal. Higher gain brightens short exposures but can increase noise and reduce highlight headroom.
luckycapture.helpoffset: Sets the black-level baseline. Increase slightly if dark pixels are clipped to zero; it does not replace gain or exposure.
luckycapture.helpbitDepth: Output format advertised by this camera driver. RAW8 uses one byte per pixel; RAW16 uses two bytes and retains the sensor precision. A 12-bit ADC commonly delivers RAW16, not a separate RAW12 format.
luckycapture.helpbinning: Reduces resolution using camera binning. Keep 1x1 when recording raw Bayer color frames.
luckycapture.helpusbLimit: Camera-specific USB transfer control. Use the driver default first; adjust only to improve transfer stability or speed.
luckycapture.helpAcquisitionMode: Automatic uses an enabled camera stream when available, otherwise repeated exposures. Repeated exposures forces normal capture; camera preview mode cannot record raw frames.
luckycapture.helpRoi: Records only part of the sensor, reducing file size and often improving frame rate. Left and top locate the crop; width and height set its size, in sensor pixels. If the camera cannot capture this region directly, the plugin crops a full frame; frame rate may stay unchanged.
luckycapture.roiSoftware: ROI is cropped from a full frame. File size is reduced; camera transfer speed is unchanged.
luckycapture.helpFormat: SER preserves raw astronomy frames. AVI uses lossless FFV1; check that your stacking software supports it.
luckycapture.helpframeLimit: Stop automatically after this many recorded frames. Leave blank for no frame limit.
luckycapture.helpdurationSeconds: Stop automatically after this many seconds. Leave blank for no time limit; if both limits are set, the first reached ends recording.
luckycapture.helpplaybackFps: Playback speed stored in the AVI file. It does not set the camera capture frame rate.
luckycapture.helptarget: Optional object name, used in the filename and recording metadata.
luckycapture.helpfilter: Optional filter name, stored in the recording metadata and available for filenames.
luckycapture.helprelativeDirectory: Optional subfolder beneath the LuckyCapture recording directory. Absolute paths and parent-directory traversal are not allowed.
luckycapture.helpfilenameTemplate: Use tokens in braces: date, time, camera, target, filter, format and sequence. A unique suffix prevents overwriting an existing recording.

luckycaptureFocus.physicalWarning: Real focuser: moves only after your approval.
luckycaptureFocus.advice: Start near visual focus with short exposures. Choose textured features, keep the target inside the analysis ROI and avoid clipping. Solar H-alpha contrast can change with etalon tuning.
luckycaptureFocus.solarTitle: Solar observing: filtering is a physical responsibility
luckycaptureFocus.solarWarning: Use a purpose-built, correctly installed and securely fitted solar filtering system or a dedicated solar telescope, following manufacturer instructions. Software cannot verify safety. Never look through unfiltered optics or place ordinary eclipse glasses behind a telescope.

luckycaptureFocus.coupled: Focus-coupled replay (adds blur to actual pixels)
luckycaptureFocus.mediaAdvice: An administrator can place SER, PNG or TIFF files in the local simulation-media directory. No uploads or URLs. Still images decode to RGB8. Raw replay does not respond to motor focus.
luckycaptureFocus.motionAck: I approve real motor movement inside this narrow envelope.
luckycaptureFocus.scoreHelp: Higher is sharper for this scene and fixed settings. Scores are not calibrated across targets or cameras. Recording is never slowed by waiting for analysis; skipped samples are counted.
luckycaptureFocus.error_LOW_FOCUS_CONFIDENCE: No reliable focus peak. Check ROI, exposure, seeing and starting focus.
luckycaptureFocus.error_NO_FOCUS_FRAMES: No fresh usable frames. Start preview and check the analysis region.
luckycaptureFocus.error_FOCUSER_LIMIT: Movement exceeds the approved travel range.
luckycaptureFocus.error_REAL_FOCUSER_NOT_ARMED: Physical motion is disarmed or its lease expired. Arm again.
luckycaptureFocus.error_FOCUSER_POSITION_MISMATCH: The focuser did not confirm the requested position.
luckycaptureFocus.error_CANCELLED: Cancelled; current position is shown below.
luckycaptureFocus.error_FOCUS_ERROR: Focus failed. Check the device and PINS log.
luckycaptureFocus.autoHelp: Start near visual focus. We will compare several positions and move to the sharpest reliable result.
luckycaptureFocus.cameraHelp: Connect a camera in PINS Equipment to use autofocus.
luckycaptureFocus.connectHelp: Connect your focuser in PINS Equipment. It will appear here automatically.
luckycaptureFocus.rawHelp: Raw replay cannot find optical focus. Enable synthetic defocus in simulation settings to test autofocus.
luckycaptureFocus.searchDistance: Searches up to {steps} steps in each direction. Adjust in Advanced if needed.
luckycaptureFocus.manualHelp: Move a little, watch the preview, and compare sharpness. Use Fine when you are close.
luckycaptureFocus.approvalHelp: Your focuser moves only after you approve the travel range.
luckycaptureFocus.bestHelp: The focuser is at the validated position. You can record now or make a manual adjustment.
luckycaptureFocus.sharpnessHelp: Higher is sharper. Compare only with the same target and settings.
luckycaptureFocus.simulationHelp: Optional: practice without a camera using generated targets or local files.
luckycaptureFocus.allowMotionHelp: This uses your connected PINS focuser. Movement is limited to the positions below.
